svg.title: A2A pairing sequence
svg.desc: Instance A creates a friendship token, sends it out of band, instance B imports it; both bind X25519 keys; A sets the URL or relay; then signed envelopes flow, audited on both sides.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A one-time friendship token carries the shared secret; nothing is exchanged with a third party unless you choose the relay.

svg.text: Every step is audited (pairing, invite, friendship). B runs a worker for A only if B's origin entry for A allows spawn_worker — default off.
